scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix blog/server install && npm --prefix blog/web install && npm --prefix qa/server install && npm --prefix qa/web install && npm --prefix shop/server install && npm --prefix shop/web install
scripts.init: npm --prefix blog/server run init && npm --prefix qa/server run init && npm --prefix shop/server run init
